title: createTable creates the SQLite sink table from the model, and a re-run upserts into it
proves: the project has no DDL file and no sqlite3 step: the first run creates journal_lines from the keys of the generate, with line_id as primary key
a second run finds the table, its columns and primary key match, and the upsert writes the same 6 rows again without an error
type= on a key sets the column type, so a key whose values are all null still gets a column; the other columns take the type of their first value
Build creates no table: it shows the planned CREATE TABLE in planned_operations and proves the rows only

each rejected class stops Build: an unknown key column, no database target, createTable on a clear, createTable on a nested generate, an empty or repeated column list, an all-null column without type= and a value type without a column type
